During the [[Separatist War]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], forces of the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] '''took over''' and occupied the settlement of [[Talloran village]].<ref name="Hungry for Information" /> Talloran was one of the first settlements the Separatists infiltrated when they arrived on the island of [[Avilatan]], and the Separatist [[Agent/Legends|agents]] found sympathizers in many of the local working-class people, who were angry over the exploitation and abuse of them by corrupt members of the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]], and got them to agree to help secure the village.<ref name="Talloran" /> The takeover did not begin until after the Separatists had [[Attack on Mannett Point|conquered]] the small island of [[Mannett Point]],<ref name="Reki inference" /> and the [[Marriage/Legends|husbands]] of some local [[Gender/Legends|women]] [[Death/Legends|died]] defending the village. In order to contain the Separatists, the Central Authority's backers in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] set up a [[Blockade of Talloran village]],<ref name="Desperate Times" /> which resulted in food shortages inside the walls of the settlement.<ref name="Talloran" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|How did the Separatists manage to take over a whole town?"<br />"Separatists have sympathizers in every village, helping them to hold towns they take over. Traitors.|The future [[Voidhound]] and [[Viidu]] in one dialogue option for the mission "Desperate Times"|<ref name="Desperate Times" />}}
The Separatist takeover of Talloran village was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', during the Prologue of the Smuggler class<ref name="Hungry for Information" /> and in the Codex entry "Talloran Village".<ref name="Talloran" />
